feature.label: KNIME CLI Local API
feature.description: Early beta. Runs a local HTTP API inside KNIME Analytics Platform so agents and scripts can drive the running application from the terminal with the knime-cli command-line tool. Relies on KNIME internals and is pinned to KNIME Analytics Platform 5.12.
